/*
 * NOVODEX LOCAL MODIFICATION
 * upstream: none (an added file)
 *
 * Listing transcriptions of the OPCODE functions whose upstream bodies the novodex/ copies guard with
 * NX_VENDORED_LISTING_ROWS (the vendored-rows pass, docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-30-vendored-rows-design.md).
 * Each body is the oracle's own instructions at the RVA in its comment, established at those addresses; the
 * oracle's code differs from what a 2026 compiler makes of the upstream source (DIFF codegen, x87 summation order),
 * so the source cannot reproduce it. Generated by docs/reconstruction/novodex-physics/tools/transcribe_rows.py from
 * evidence/raw/vendored-rows-opcode-20261030/cfg.py; proven by evidence/vendored-rows-opcode-listing-compare.py.
 */
#include "Stdafx.h"

// The transcribed Model::Build calls AABBTreeOfTrianglesBuilder's inline constructor (row 005360) out of line. With
// the upstream Build guarded off nothing else instantiates it, so this keeps it as its own out-of-line COMDAT, the
// code row 005360's record names. It is never called.
#pragma inline_depth(0)
extern "C" void nxOpKeepBuilderConstructor(void* builder)
{
	::new (builder) AABBTreeOfTrianglesBuilder;
}
#pragma inline_depth()
